'''Doghramaj''' ({{Langx|az|Doğramac}}) or '''Ovdukh''' ({{Langx|az|Ovduq}}; {{Langx|ttt|Ov Dug}}) is a cold [[Azerbaijani cuisine|Azerbaijani]] and [[Tat people (Caucasus)|Tat]] soup. It is a version of the Russian soup [[Okroshka]], with minor differences separating the two, and similar to another warm soup from the territory of Azerbaijan, [[Dovga]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=2018-05-26 |title=Doğramac |url=https://kayzen.az/blog/Az%C9%99rbaycan-m%C9%99tb%C9%99xi/21702/do%C4%9Framac.html |access-date=2025-03-01 |website=Kayzen |language=ru}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Ovdukh {{!}} Traditional Cold Soup From Azerbaijan {{!}} TasteAtlas |url=https://www.tasteatlas.com/ovdukh |access-date=2025-08-26 |website=www.tasteatlas.com}}</ref>
